title: Stop Early, Stay Simple: Evidence Acquisition for Power System Fault and Attack Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2611.21695v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diagnostic models for cyber-physical power systems usually inspect every telemetry source for every event, although some events are clear from one source and others need several. We ask when a learned policy for choosing that evidence is worth its added complexity. To answer this, we present ActiGrid, a benchmark framework for active evidence acquisition that pairs a classifier trained to tolerate missing modalities with a Double Deep Q-Network (DQN), which either requests another source or stops and diagnoses but never operates grid actuators. On the public TU Delft digital substation and MSU/ORNL power system attack benchmarks, we compare the DQN with fixed subsets and orders, calibrated entropy stopping, a greedy value of information rule, and tree ensembles trained per subset. The learned policy does adapt to what it observes, yet it is statistically indistinguishable from entropy stopping on TU Delft and Pareto dominated by simple

translated_title: 早停从简：面向电力系统故障与攻击诊断的证据获取
translated_abstract: 面向信息物理电力系统的诊断模型通常对每个事件都检查所有遥测数据源，尽管有些事件从单一数据源即可清晰判断，而另一些则需要多个数据源。我们探讨的问题是：学习型的证据选择策略何时才值得其带来的额外复杂性。为回答这一问题，我们提出了 ActiGrid，一个主动证据获取的基准测试框架，它将一个经训练能够容忍模态缺失的分类器与双重深度Q网络相结合——该网络要么请求另一个数据源，要么停止并给出诊断，但从不操作电网执行器。在公开的TU Delft数字化变电站和MSU/ORNL电力系统攻击基准上，我们将该DQN与固定子集和固定顺序、校准熵停止准则、贪心信息价值规则以及按子集训练的树集成模型进行了比较。学习到的策略确实能够根据其观察到的内容进行自适应调整，但在TU Delft数据集上，它与熵停止方法在统计上不可区分，并且被更简单的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出ActiGrid主动证据获取基准框架，通过实验发现学习型DQN证据选择策略相比简单的熵停止等基线并无显著优势甚至被其帕累托支配，表明电力系统故障与攻击诊断中简单方法往往已足够。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ActiGrid, an active evidence acquisition benchmark for power system fault and attack diagnosis, showing that a learned DQN evidence-selection policy is statistically indistinguishable from or Pareto-dominated by simple entropy-based stopping, suggesting simpler methods often suffice.
